description: Load a manifest of agent cards (URL or local file) and emit one declare-only AssetSpec per entry -- the multi-asset 'workspace' sibling of AgentCardComponent.

outputs.description: One declare-only agent card per manifest entry (lineage + metadata, no compute)

manifest_url.label: Manifest Url
manifest_url.description: URL serving a JSON array (or {"agents": [...]}/{"cards": [...]}) of agent-card objects.

manifest_path.label: Manifest Path
manifest_path.description: Local file with the same shape as manifest_url. Takes precedence over manifest_url if both are set.

include_ids.label: Include Ids
include_ids.description: If set, only agent_ids in this list are emitted.

include_tags.label: Include Tags
include_tags.description: If set, only cards with at least one skill tag in this list are emitted.

max_agents.label: Max Agents
max_agents.description: Defensive cap on how many cards from the manifest are emitted as assets.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group name applied to every emitted asset.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners applied to every emitted asset.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Extra asset tags applied to every emitted asset.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Prefix for every emitted asset key.

name: Agent Card Workspace
